video_title: REACTION: Knicks are Champions! Full NBA Finals Game 5 Recap + Jalen Brunson’s HISTORIC performance

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Knicks' long-awaited championship victory
quotes.excerpt: to see them hoist up that trophy was special to see Stephen A. that emotional was well worth it
quotes.quote: Long time coming. These boys went out here and did what we could not. There has been plenty of players that have come through. We have all tried to take on that story for the city, try and get them as far along as we can. I made a second round, but to see them hoist up that trophy was special to see Stephen A. that emotional was well worth it, honestly for me.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's historic playoff run and MVP status
quotes.excerpt: certainly this was the best playoff run I think by a Knick of all time
quotes.quote: Certainly this was the best playoff run I think by a Knick of all time. And by the way, all respect to OG Anunoby, but it was not a difficult decision for the MVP at the end because this was unanimous. Even Bontemps got it right.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson as the smartest and toughest player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the smartest and toughest player in the entire NBA
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is the smartest and toughest player in the entire NBA, and that is why the Knicks are champions and it is why he is the greatest free agent signing in the history of the sport. He is not LeBron James, he is not Shaquille O'Neal, but the signing of Jalen Brunson to the Knicks for a contract of four years, $104 million, that at the time was deemed by plenty of people to be either a solid signing or an overpay, for him to become the player that put this franchise on his back, scored 45 out of 94 points in this game, carried this franchise that had had so many down moments and so many years of futility and had this whole legion of fans that never thought they were going to win, all the way through these playoffs, beating Victor Wembanyama in the series, making clutch shot after clutch shot at the end, and instilling this mental fortitude in this Knicks team that has come back from down 20, five different times in the last two playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's leadership and Finals MVP case
quotes.excerpt: he is the Finals MVP favorite because he didn't have it going but he still kept them in games
quotes.quote: I think that is one of the bigger reasons that he is the Finals MVP favorite because he did not have it going, but he still kept them in games, game after game. He kept them close. He let his team know, if you keep me within striking distance, I may not be able to throw it in the ocean all game, but when you need it, I will be there. And because he did it against a defense that was breaking, and he did it against a defense that was breaking, and he did it against a defense that was breaking. This is for Al Horford, this is for Damian Lillard should be happy to see this, because now he understands, man, maybe if I do these things, if I sacrifice these things, I can win too.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson as the ultimate team captain
quotes.excerpt: he is the epitome of a captain because he is their floor leader, their emotional leader
quotes.quote: He is really the epitome of a captain. Because he is their floor leader, their emotional leader, he sets the tone for the team, and he took less money so those dudes all could get paid.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Mavericks' failure to retain Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: the last game Rick Carlisle coached Jalen Brunson, Trey Burke got minutes in a game seven over him
quotes.quote: The last game Rick Carlisle coached Jalen Brunson, Trey Burke got minutes in a game seven over him after he was a massive part of the Mavericks getting to the Western Conference Finals, going for 41 and 31 in playoff wins when Luka Doncic was hurt against the Jazz and having a great series against the Suns and all that. The Mavericks, Cuban can say what he want, they did not bid to try to keep him.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's learning experience from the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: this is the biggest lesson of my life, the biggest learning moment
quotes.quote: I think that compared to anything before, this is the biggest lesson of my life, the biggest learning moment. I cannot tell you exactly what the lesson is, but we are learning from that for sure. I am learning more than any time in my life before. It is just like when LeBron James lost his first Finals, it is just like when Shaquille O'Neal lost to the Rockets.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's need for better defensive principles
quotes.excerpt: as a defensive player of the year, your defensive principles have got to be better
quotes.quote: As a defensive player of the year, your defensive principles have got to be better. When you watch film this summer, I want you to accept your responsibility in this for just defensive positioning, because I saw at least six to eight times, if your body is just in the right place at the right time doing the right thing, there is no way for some of the stuff happened to have happened.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' masterclass in roster building and trades
quotes.excerpt: they went out and built this team in a variety of different ways
quotes.quote: They went out and built this team in a variety of different ways, and it was not just with picks at the top of the draft, and they made creative trades, and they made an incredible free agent signing, and got some, you know, got Landry Shamet off the scrap heap as a minimum free agent, drafted Miles McBride in the second round, drafted Mitchell Robinson a long time ago in the second round. Building a team in that kind of manner in a lot of different ways, that is what the league was hoping to achieve in this last CBA.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Pressure on NBA player development coaches
quotes.excerpt: there is more pressure on the rest of you GMs around the league to build your roster
quotes.quote: There is more pressure on the rest of you GMs around the league to build your roster. Put some veterans on your team, put some leadership, some ball handling, some shooting, some guys that may not do everything else, but they will get the game winning offensive rebound. Shout out Peter Patton. You better be putting people in position where they understand that at the end of games, this is what we need you to do. Player development coaches, step up. Look around. The Knicks won for a reason.
